title: XShell Page Implementation
description: Describes the implementation object of an XShell Page.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this page.

query.description: Whether the property may be initialized from the Page URL query string.

context.description: Whether the property may be initialized from Page context.

state.description: Whether the property is backed by Page state.

reflect.description: Whether property changes are reflected to enabled external representations.

dependencies.description: Declarative dependencies resolved before the Page controller is created. Each property name becomes an injected controller dependency.

renderEngine.description: The rendering engine used by the Page.

stateEngine.description: The state management engine used by the Page.

classes.description: CSS classes applied to the Page.

shadowRootOptions.description: Options for the Page's shadow root.

templateRenderer.description: Optional generated or prepared executable representation of the template.

controller.description: Controller factory called by XShell with Page runtime services and resolved dependencies.
